context.statement: A bank audits credit‑scoring models for disparate approval and error rates across demographic groups—including culturally diverse customer segments—documents findings, and implements bias‑mitigation steps before deployment.

suggestions.description: Applicants from some groups are declined more often because bureau and account-behaviour features act as proxies for sex, ethnicity or age.

incidents.title: Apple Card's Credit Assessment Algorithm Allegedly Discriminated against Women
Navy Federal Credit Union Faces Allegations of Racial Bias in Mortgage Approvals

suggestions.why: "No special-category data" does not stop proxies: "bureau history … account-behaviour features" can encode protected traits.

suggestions.description: Approval and default rates shift after a rate change or economic shock, and the quarterly retrain leaves applicants mis-scored for months before anyone notices.

incidents.title: Zillow Shut Down Zillow Offers Division Allegedly Due to Predictive Pricing Tool's Insufficient Accuracy

suggestions.why: "Quarterly retrain on a rolling 36-month window" means a sudden shift goes unmodelled until the next cycle.

suggestions.description: Declined applicants receive reason codes that do not reflect what drove the score, so they cannot understand or effectively contest the decision.

incidents.title: Australian Automated Debt Assessment System Issued False Notices to Thousands

suggestions.why: The canvas promises "reason codes the servicing channel can actually read back" from "gradient-boosted trees … plus a calibration layer", which are hard to explain faithfully.

suggestions.description: Underwriters under time pressure confirm declines the score recommends without real review, so applicants lose the meaningful human check that data protection law expects.

incidents.title: UnitedHealth Accused of Deploying Allegedly Flawed AI to Deny Medical Coverage

suggestions.why: "A decline is confirmed by an underwriter" combined with "cuts decision latency from days to minutes" invites rubber-stamping.

suggestions.description: Young applicants, recent movers and newcomers with thin bureau files are scored less accurately, so creditworthy people are declined or sent to referral.

incidents.title: Schufa Credit Scoring in Germany Reported for Unreliable and Imbalanced Scores

suggestions.why: The default probability is "predicted from bureau history", which is short or missing for these applicants.

context.statement: In a new accuracy benchmark, hallucination rates across 26 top models range from 22% to 94%.

suggestions.description: Agents pass on a copilot answer that its cited policy does not support, so customers get wrong fee or refund terms and lose money.

incidents.title: Air Canada Chatbot Reportedly Provides Inaccurate Bereavement Fare Information, Leading to Customer Overpayment
Anysphere AI Support Bot for Cursor Reportedly Invents Login Policy, Leading to Subscription Cancellations

suggestions.why: "Consistent answers, and a visible source the agent can quote back" means customers act on whatever the copilot says, and a wrong answer looks backed by a source.

suggestions.description: A customer hides instructions in their message that take over the copilot, so it reveals its hidden instructions or steers agents towards unauthorised concessions.

mit.subdomain: 2.2 AI system security vulnerabilities and attacks

incidents.title: Chevrolet Dealer Chatbot Agrees to Sell Tahoe for $1
Bing Chat's Initial Prompts Revealed by Early Testers Through Prompt Injection

suggestions.why: "customer text" in the data strategy means text the bank does not control goes into the model's prompt.

suggestions.description: A withdrawn or replaced policy stays in the nightly index, so agents quote old fees and customers are charged or refused on outdated terms.

incidents.title: Microsoft-Powered New York City Chatbot Advises Illegal Practices

suggestions.why: "the index is rebuilt nightly" over a "versioned policy corpus" means every rebuild must drop withdrawn versions, or a well-sourced answer can still be out of date.

suggestions.description: Retrieval over a shared index shows agents documents meant for other business units, so confidential terms reach staff not entitled to see them.

mit.subdomain: 2.1 Compromise of privacy by obtaining, leaking or correctly inferring sensitive information

incidents.title: ChatGPT Reportedly Exposed Users' Private Data Reportedly Due to Bug

suggestions.why: "Retrieval-augmented generation over the versioned policy corpus" does not limit retrieval to the agent's own business unit, and the copilot's shared index has already returned other units' document titles (incident n8).

suggestions.description: Under handling-time pressure, agents read out copilot answers without opening the cited source, so the human check that protects customers quietly stops happening.

incidents.title: ChatGPT Reportedly Produced False Court Case Law Presented by Legal Counsel in Court

suggestions.why: "Shorter handling times … without moving the decision away from the agent" puts speed targets against the agent's own check.

suggestions.description: Agents paste customers' account and personal details into the copilot, and prompts kept in logs at the model provider break the promise that customer text is not retained.

mit.subdomain: 2.1 Compromise of privacy by obtaining, leaking or correctly inferring sensitive information

incidents.title: ChatGPT Reportedly Implicated in Samsung Data Leak of Source Code and Meeting Notes

suggestions.why: "customer text is never retained beyond the session" is a promise that has to hold at the model provider and in logs, not only in the bank's own store.

context.statement: Colorado’s Artificial Intelligence Act, signed in May 2024, was among the first state laws targeting algorithmic discrimination in decisions such as hiring, housing, and medical care.

suggestions.description: Women, older and disabled candidates could be ranked lower because CV fields acting as protected-group proxies stay in the match score unaudited.

incidents.title: Amazon's Experimental Hiring Tool Allegedly Displayed Gender Bias in Candidate Rankings
Workday's AI Tools Allegedly Enabled Employers to Discriminate against Applicants of Protected Groups

suggestions.why: "which fields must be excluded as protected-group proxies is undecided" means proxies can still shape the score.

suggestions.description: Candidates could be ranked by a high-risk hiring system before anyone has assessed and signed off its effect on their fundamental rights.

incidents.title: Workday's AI Tools Allegedly Enabled Employers to Discriminate against Applicants of Protected Groups

suggestions.why: "held at the gate" shows the impact assessment that would release it is not yet signed off.

suggestions.description: Recruiters' own biases in past shortlists could be learned by each new version, steadily narrowing which candidates reach the shortlist.

incidents.title: Amazon's Experimental Hiring Tool Allegedly Displayed Gender Bias in Candidate Rankings
LinkedIn Search Prefers Male Names

suggestions.why: "recruiter shortlist decisions are the feedback" feeds human choices back into training.

suggestions.description: Rejected candidates get no reason for the outcome, so they cannot challenge a ranking that may have wrongly screened them out.

incidents.title: Eightfold AI Hiring Tools Allegedly Secretly Scored Job Applicants for Employers

suggestions.why: "a rejected candidate cannot yet be given the reason for the outcome".

suggestions.description: Candidates' health, ethnicity, religion or union membership, stated or inferable from CV text, could be processed without a lawful basis or safeguards.

incidents.title: Eightfold AI Hiring Tools Allegedly Secretly Scored Job Applicants for Employers

suggestions.why: "special-category data is in scope and unresolved".

suggestions.description: The bank could be unable to audit or explain rankings to candidates because the vendor-built model's training data and design stay undisclosed.

incidents.title: Workday's AI Tools Allegedly Enabled Employers to Discriminate against Applicants of Protected Groups
Eightfold AI Hiring Tools Allegedly Secretly Scored Job Applicants for Employers

suggestions.why: "shared document embedding model, co-built with TalentRank Partners" puts key design facts with a vendor.

suggestions.description: Recruiters facing high volumes could accept the ranking unread, so lower-ranked candidates are rejected in practice without any human review.

incidents.title: Workday's AI Tools Allegedly Enabled Employers to Discriminate against Applicants of Protected Groups
